I grow beans on this small plot to help feed my family, but my main focus and any inputs I can get go to my maize. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does, and I do not have enough manure to spread here when my larger fields need it too. My children and I will manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since this is only a small piece of land.
